citations.citation: For the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which many neutral atoms trapped at a magic wavelength are interrogated at once, bringing frequency measurement to the 10^-18 level

For the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which neutral atoms trapped at a magic wavelength are interrogated in large numbers, bringing frequency standards to the 10^-18 level
For the invention and realisation of the optical lattice clock, in which many neutral atoms are trapped at a magic wavelength, bringing frequency measurement to the 10^-18 level

For the invention and development of optical lattice clocks, in which many neutral atoms trapped at the magic wavelength are interrogated simultaneously, bringing frequency measurement to the 10^-18 level

for the invention of the optical lattice clock, in which neutral atoms confined at a magic wavelength are interrogated in large numbers, and for its development to a fractional uncertainty of 10^-18, opening new tests of fundamental physics and relativistic geodesy
